newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates fall in flush market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates fall in flush market.

text.p: Egyptian pound overnight rates slipped on Thursday in a liquid private sector market to between 9-3/4 and 10 percent from 10-3/16 and 10-1/4 percent on Wednesday, bankers said.
The market is usually liquid on Thursday, the last working day before the weekend.
Bankers said one week rates also fell to around 10-1/8 percent from 10-1/4 and 10-5/16 percent.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent, bankers said.
